Step Expected: Status is DOWN. The guard at CollectorResponseProcessor.java:191 / ResponseProcessor.java:634 must read !isUP && !isDOWN; with the shipped || it is a tautology and always overwrites to UNKNOWN. Expect a fail until fixed
